ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible surface area exhibits a high-contrast bimodal distribution, approximately 55% white (high intensity) and 45% black (low intensity).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe (ventral) is predominantly high-intensity white with a low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge and base. Right lobe (ventral) is primarily low-intensity black with a localized high-intensity white patch on the outer-third of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured interior angle of approximately 40 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge exhibiting irregular peaks and valleys; right lobe shows more frequent, sharper serrations compared to the smoother, broader waves on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges of both lobes exhibit a generally convex curve, with a transition to a concave sweep as they approach the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent high-contrast clusters of roughly circular, multi-colored pixel aggregates (barnacles) are located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, linear pixel tracks (rake marks) are visible running roughly parallel to the longitudinal axis on the white surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant encrustation of acorn barnacles on the trailing edge tips, causing localized structural distortion of the fluke silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive mottled transition zone on the right lobe where black pigmentation fades into the white distal patch.
